channel.title: Blender Tutoring Blog
channel.description: Practical Blender guides for beginners and game artists.

item.title: Blender for Beginners: The Order to Learn It In
item.description: A complete starting guide — which version to install, the keys that matter on day one, what to build after the donut, and a 30-day plan that fits around a job. Free PDF included.

item.title: Blender Texture Not Showing: Magenta, Grey, or Nothing at All
item.description: Five different problems all look like a missing texture. Magenta means one thing, flat grey another, one solid colour a third. Read the symptom first.

item.title: Your AI-Generated Mesh Looks Fine. That Is the Problem.
item.description: I rendered a generated mesh beside a clean one and could not tell them apart. The costs are real and none of them show up in the render.

item.title: Blender MCP in 2026: What the Setup Guides Leave Out
item.description: The package was renamed, the version requirements contradict each other, and the code tool has no sandbox. What the walkthroughs leave out.

item.title: Blender Geometry Nodes: The Three Ideas That Make It Click
item.description: Fields, domains and the spreadsheet — the three ideas tutorials skip while teaching recipes. Plus the socket shapes that changed in 2025.

item.title: Blender FBX Export: Fixing Wrong Scale and Rotation
item.description: Your model lands a hundred times too big or lying on its side. Why every guide gives different settings, and the two-minute test that settles it.

item.title: Blender Running Slow? Viewport Lag, Freezes and Fixes
item.description: Blender is slow describes three different problems with three different causes. Work out which one you have before you change a single setting.

item.title: Blender Shading Artifacts: Why Your Model Has Black Patches
item.description: Black faces, smudged curves, a grey band down a bevel — six causes that look alike, in the order worth checking. Plus what Blender 4.1 changed.

item.title: Weight Painting in Blender: Why Your Rig Deforms Badly
item.description: Most weight-painting pain is not a painting problem. The mesh, the scale and the normalisation to fix first — plus why the candy-wrapper needs a bone.

item.title: Why Your Blender Materials Look Like Plastic
item.description: Four fixable causes, starting with a colour space checkbox that quietly ruins every data map — plus what changed in the Principled BSDF in Blender 4.0.

item.title: What a Game Art Portfolio Actually Needs in 2026
item.description: Job postings describe the role in detail, for free. The gap between what they ask for and what most junior portfolios show — and how to close it.

item.title: Quads vs Triangles in Blender: What Actually Matters
item.description: Your engine triangulates everything on export, so the never-use-triangles rule misses the point. Where quads genuinely matter, and why n-gons are worse.

item.title: Why Your Blender Render Looks Flat
item.description: Flat renders are a lighting problem, not a modelling one. The greyscale test, the four usual causes, and a three-point setup that reliably works.

item.title: Why Your Blender Render Is Noisy — and How to Fix It
item.description: Noise is four different problems, not one. How to tell grain from fireflies from caustics, what fixes each, and why raising the sample count comes last.

item.title: Should You Upgrade to Blender 5.2 LTS?
item.description: Your files are fine — your addons are the risk. What the 5.x Python changes broke, a ten-minute check before you move, and when to simply wait.

item.title: Text-to-3D in Blender: What AI Can and Can't Model Yet
item.description: An honest look at AI 3D generators in a real Blender pipeline — what they save you, where the topology falls apart, and the jobs they are actually good for.

item.title: Connecting GPT-6 Astra to Blender
item.description: Astra can drive Blender directly through MCP rather than handing you Python to paste. Here's the setup, a worked example, and where it stops being useful.

item.title: Mastering the Mirror Modifier in Blender
item.description: Model half, get the whole thing. How the Mirror Modifier works, the three settings that matter, and the mistakes that make it misbehave.

item.title: Blender and Unreal Engine: The Happy Couple
item.description: One authors, the other makes it real-time — and both are free. Why this pairing is the most powerful free setup in 3D, and the gotchas nobody warns you about.

item.title: Cycles vs EEVEE: Which Blender Render Engine Should You Use?
item.description: Blender ships with two render engines and never explains which to pick. Here's the honest answer, and when each one is the right call.

item.title: UV Unwrapping in Blender, Without the Panic
item.description: UV unwrapping is where most Blender beginners get stuck. Here's what UVs actually are, why your texture looks stretched, and the workflow that fixes it.

item.title: What to Make After the Blender Donut Tutorial
item.description: Finished Blender's famous donut tutorial? Here's how to escape tutorial hell and start making work that's actually yours.

item.title: The Most Important Blender Keyboard Shortcuts for Beginners
item.description: Stop clicking through menus. These Blender keyboard shortcuts will immediately speed up your workflow — learn them once, use them forever.

item.title: The Best Free Blender Tutorials for Beginners (2026)
item.description: You don't need to spend a penny to learn Blender. Here are the best free tutorials and YouTube channels — curated and honest.

item.title: 10 Blender Modeling Addons Every Beginner Should Know
item.description: New to Blender? These 10 modeling addons will speed up your workflow from day one — including 7 that are completely free and already built into Blender.

item.title: How Long Does It Take to Learn Blender From Scratch?
item.description: Wondering how long it takes to learn Blender? Here's an honest, experience-based breakdown — no hype, no shortcuts.
